subject: Whistic consistency smoke test & profile seed request
messages:
From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@cardinalcare.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: secops@cardinalcare.io
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic consistency smoke test & profile seed request

Hi Mina / Redwood team,

We just finished an internal review of vendor profiles and noticed a few inconsistencies between the public Whistic entries and the CAIQ/SIG artifacts we've received back from vendors. CardinalCare is targeting a procurement kickoff with our platform team the week of July 12, so we'd like to run a quick "consistency smoke test" with Redwood's Whistic profile for CardinalCare.

What we'd like:
- A shallow verification across the profile pages (security overview, encryption, SOC2 status) to confirm fields are populated and not diverging from the attached scoping matrix.
- A small seed upload (3–5 representative artifacts) into Whistic to validate your KMS-signed artifact flow and proof-of-possession handling.
- A short checklist + remediation notes if you see mismatches we should triage on our end.

Attachments: scoping_matrix.xlsx (high level mapping of expected fields)

Questions:
1) Can Redwood accept a temporary presigned S3 upload from CardinalCare for the seed bundle, or do you prefer a signed upload from our end?
2) For KMS-signed evidence, what key metadata does Redwood surface in Whistic (digest, signing key id, timestamp)?

If we can get a 48–72 hour turnaround that would be ideal — we just need a rapid smoke check and a short write-up to circulate to procurement.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—
Alice Johnson
Sr. Vendor Security Manager | CardinalCare
alice.johnson@cardinalcare.io
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@cardinalcare.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic consistency smoke test & profile seed request

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the matrix. We can run the smoke test and seed the profile with a small artifact bundle this week. High level plan:

1) Acceptance method: we prefer presigned S3 uploads for the seed bundle (short TTL) so your team can push artifacts directly; we will download to a dedicated ingestion bucket and create KMS-signed proof objects in our evidence pipeline.

2) What we'll validate: profile field parity (CAIQ mapping), artifact accessibility and metadata, KMS signature presence, and Whistic UI rendering for attachments.

3) Deliverables: short status note (pass/fail per section), list of mismatches with recommended ownership, and a zipped seed-evidence log (no PII).

Action items:
- Alice: share presigned S3 PUTs for up to 5 artifacts or let us know if you want us to generate PUTs from our side.
- Marcus: will run the ingestion and KMS-sign flow; I assigned SEC-721 for tracking.
- Rishi / Monica: please double-check the CAIQ mapping rules (encryption and key lifecycle) before we push the evidence so we avoid churn.

Timeline: we can start ingestion today if we have presigned links; report out within 48 hours of ingest.

Mina / Alice — quick technical notes from the ingestion side:

- Presigned S3: TTL of 1 hour is fine. Please name the artifacts with the convention cardinalcare_<doctype>_<shortid>.pdf/zip. That reduces collisions and speeds mapping during ingest.
- KMS-signed evidence: our pipeline will compute the SHA256 digest, sign it with our HSM-backed KMS key (redwood-evidence-prod), and produce a small JSON proof file with fields: digest, key_id (KMS ARN), and signature_b64. We then attach that proof as metadata to the Whistic artifact entry.
- For the smoke test we will also capture a short verification log (who accessed the object, ingest timestamp, and signature verification result).

I created JIRA SEC-721 and added a checklist and small script to verify signature locally (link below). We can also provide a sample signed proof for you to validate on your side.

JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-721
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-smoketest-scripts
